title: Unbound: Building And Forging
description:
Small mod focused on adding new Building Blocks and Decorations

The mod with done with MCreator
body:
The mods adds:
-Marble, a brand new Building Material that you can get by trading with Villagers, can be used to craft Building Blocks
-Coins, can be made out of Copper, Iron, or Gold, and can be used to trade with Villagers as an alternative for Emeralds
-Charred Wood, can be done by smelting any Wood Planks, can be used to craft Building Blocks
-Wrought Iron, obtained by smelting Iron Ingots, can be used to craft Building Blocks and Decorations
-Pottery, can be used to store Items
-Round Awnings (WIP)
